records.subject: Sorry to see you go
records.body:

Your Wrenfield subscription is canceled. If it was something specific that didn't fit, let us know -- it helps us improve.

Cheers,

records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Wanted to check in on Summit Systems' setup. If you haven't gotten to inviting the rest of the team yet, no rush -- just let me know if anything's in the way.

records.text: handing off summit systems to whoever has bandwidth this week

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Summit Systems
records.body:
Hi Mia,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreaches (email:6fea7327, email:793d74d0); internal handoff note suggests low engagement (slack:14d47680). No tickets or stated intent. 8 days left, but silence from a fully unstarted Team account makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Summit Systems started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Checking in once more on Summit Systems. Nothing has been set up in Wrenfield yet, and I don't want that to be because something is unclear on our end.

Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is the natural starting point. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to sit with you while you get the first project in place and answer anything about your Team plan.

Best,
Priya
